programs.title: Instant Hotel
programs.desc: We are off to the golden beaches of the Gold Coast to stay at an instant hotel owned by wacky couple, Lynne and Simon. What local activities will be on offer? One of them will stand out.

programs.title: Dancing With The Stars
programs.desc: Our stars continue to impress the expert international judging panel of Craig Revel-Horwood, Helen Richey, Sharna Burgess and Mark Wilson.

programs.title: The Bad Guys
programs.desc: Never have there been five friends as infamous as The Bad Guys—Mr. Wolf, Mr. Snake, Mr. Piranha, Mr. Shark and Ms. Tarantula. After years of countless heists and being the world’s most-wanted villains, the gang is finally caught. Mr. Wolf brokers a deal to keep them out of prison and the Bad Guys set out to fool the world into believing they’ve gone good. Packed with huge laughs and edgy action, being bad has never been so fun in this action-comedy from DreamWorks Animation based on the best-selling book series.

programs.title: Bridesmaids
programs.desc: Annie's life is a mess. But when she finds out her lifetime best friend is engaged, she simply must serve as Lillian's maid of honour. Though lovelorn and broke, Annie bluffs her way through the expensive and bizarre rituals. With one chance to get it perfect, she'll show Lillian and her bridesmaids just how far you'll go for someone you love.

programs.title: This Is 40
programs.desc: As a wife and husband both prepare for their 40th birthdays, their desire to celebrate is nearly overshadowed by their life of frustration dealing with rowdy children, unsuccessful careers and potentially ruinous financial debt.

programs.title: Emergency Call
programs.desc: Call taker Luke starts his shift at ESTA 000's ambulance call centre with a call from a frantic mother, who has tripped and dropped her young baby.
